en: A pull request's run ends at its first red. So the last step of every gate job of <t1/>, on <t2/> of a <t3/> event alone, cancels the run by its own id with the job's token (<t4/>); <t5/> and <t6/> still run, because they run <t7/>, and report the run red. A combined top, a pull request whose head is an <t8/> branch, is never cancelled this way: it carries many heads and is judged once for all of them, so one run of it shows every red (on 2026-10-15 the grand top took three full cycles to show three reds). A push to master, the schedule and a dispatch are never cancelled this way: the trunk's remaining jobs are the only reading of its other lanes.
